string.name: igd_title
string.value: One-time IGDv2 lease

string.name: igd_risk
string.value: Prefer a VPN. This can expose unencrypted HTTP controls or RTSP video, audio and reusable login credentials to the Internet. A strong password does not encrypt the connection.

string.name: igd_lifetime
string.value: Request: TCP, gateway-selected external port (suggestion 0), 60 seconds starting when the gateway processes the request. Stopping the app service does not delete or renew the lease. Neither immediate revocation nor gateway compliance is guaranteed. On timeout or any unknown result, check the gateway manually. The app will not resend.

string.name: igd_unprovisioned
string.value: No reviewed create-only gateway is configured in this build. Automatic mapping on ordinary routers is not enabled. No gateway will be contacted.

string.name: igd_enable
string.value: Configure one request on a Wi-Fi gateway I administer

string.name: igd_pair
string.value: In your gateway’s authenticated administrator console, set this fresh challenge for its reviewed create-only policy. Do not proceed on shared or unmanaged Wi-Fi. The app never configures the gateway for you.

string.name: igd_url
string.value: Exact HTTPS description URL from your administrator console

string.name: igd_auth
string.value: Select a service already listening with a non-default strong password (12–63 printable ASCII characters, upper and lower case and digits). Legacy HTTP password URLs are not eligible. This does not start a service.

string.name: igd_http
string.value: Review HTTP lease

string.name: igd_rtsp
string.value: Review RTSP lease

string.name: igd_first
string.value: 1 of 2 · Public exposure

string.name: igd_cancel
string.value: Cancel

string.name: igd_review
string.value: I administer this gateway; review request

string.name: igd_final
string.value: 2 of 2 · Send one request?

string.name: igd_details
string.value: Expose plaintext %s at %s:%d via gateway %s:%d. Credentials and camera data may be intercepted. Request one new TCP port, suggestion 0, for 60 seconds from gateway processing. Stopping does not revoke or renew it. The gateway may not comply; check it manually if the outcome is unknown. Prefer a VPN.

string.name: igd_send
string.value: Accept public exposure and send once

string.name: igd_pending
string.value: Checking the configured gateway for this request…

string.name: igd_blocked
string.value: No mapping request sent. Check the selected listener, credentials, exact URL, Wi-Fi route, certificate and create-only pairing policy.

string.name: igd_unknown
string.value: The request may have been processed. Do not resend. Check the gateway’s mappings manually.

string.name: igd_success
string.value: Gateway reported external TCP port %d. This does not verify Internet reachability or expiry. Check the gateway to verify the mapping.
